description: This file defines the ServerCommand class which extends the Command class to configure and run a server silo with various options and a handler, as well as a static Server class to create commands.

classes.name: ServerCommand<T>
classes.description: A command class for configuring and running a server silo with specified options and a run handler.

methods.name: ServerCommand<T>
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the command with options and a handler for running the server.

methods.name: CreateCommand<T>
methods.description: Static method to create a new ServerCommand with a given configurator.
